n_main.text:
VIDEO RESULT, dev notes
• Timeline segment click: seek video to claim start, scroll its card into view, set card active (blue ring).
• Claim card click / Enter: open Claim detail drawer (URL /videos/[id]?claim=[cid] so it is linkable).
• Playing video: the card whose time range contains currentTime gets the active ring.
• 'What this means' line is derived from stance + verdict (table on DevNotes). Never free text from the model.
• Confidence: show 'Not yet calibrated' until calibration exists. Tweak 'calibrated' shows the later state.
• Review banner only when review_reasons is non-empty.

n_detail.text:
CLAIM DETAIL
• Drawer on desktop and tablet, full page on phone. Esc and the X close it and restore focus to the card.
• Evidence split Contradicts / Supports, strongest study type first.
• Critic's notes: <details>, collapsed by default.
• Internal library docs never get an external link.

n_jobs.text:
JOBS + PROGRESS
• Jobs list polls every 10 s only while any visible row is Queued / Running / Retrying; stops otherwise.
• Job page polls GET /jobs/[id] every 3 s (back off to 10 s after 3 min; stop on Completed / Failed / Needs review), and on tab focus.
• On Completed or Needs review: auto-route to the result.
• Elapsed time is computed client-side from started_at.

n_review.text:
REVIEW
• A reason is required for every decision; Save stays disabled until it's filled.
• Reviewers can't decide their own submissions (also enforced server-side).
• Correcting claims doesn't recompute the label; the panel warns on mismatch.
• Audit trail is append-only and shows who, what, when.

n_v2.text:
WHAT CHANGED vs. 5
1. Finding as a sentence ('This video promotes a false cure for the flu'), badge demoted to a tag.
2. Claim map: speaker stance × evidence. MISINFO and DEBUNKED are opposite corners, so the core distinction is spatial, not just colour. Unsettled claims sit in a dashed gutter, never on the map.
3. Claims and transcript merged: transcript is the spine, claims are margin notes on the line where they were said. No tabs.
4. Evidence pyramid glyph replaces '2 contradict · 0 support' as the lead signal: shows which study levels exist, so one systematic review outweighs three lab studies.
5. Linked selection: a number on the map, timeline or transcript highlights the same claim everywhere (try it in Play).

n_d3.text:
DIRECTION 3: what the research changed
• Style: clinical evidence summary (GRADE 'Summary of findings' rows, footnoted reasons) + annotated manuscript (serif transcript, claims in the margin) inside a calm institutional shell.
• Verdict shown small and last: an 'Assessment' line with the reasoning chain, not a hero badge.
• Wording: 'Contradicted by evidence', 'Insufficient evidence'. System output marked 'System assessment' until an analyst confirms.
• Evidence strip (SR / RCT / OBS / LAB + guidance) with ▲▼ direction, replacing counts and the pyramid.
• 2×2 map dropped for a stance × evidence table (empty rows hidden). The 2×2 can live in help.
• Review: high-priority items ask the analyst to judge before the system's answer is revealed (reduces over-reliance; slower).
• Dark mode: research says defer; the toggle stays but isn't a priority.
